there are a number of options available to the food industry to produce foods with a reduced fat content and a modified fatty acid profile.
the food industry has made great strides in improving the healthiness of its products, but more work needs to be done.

fats for the food industry should be as low in saturated fat as possible, with the least amount of trans fatty acids and the highest possible amounts of monounsaturated and polyunsaturated fats, especially omega-3 fatty acids.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we need to be aware of the implications of our food products and their ingredients on our health and the health of others.

The main takeaway from our work is that
, in order to reduce the intake of fat and saturated fatty acids, the food industry needs to be innovative, creative and flexible.
there are a number of options available to the food industry, but the challenge is to make the best choice for the consumer.

the food industry can play a major role in the prevention of cardiovascular disease and other diet-related chronic diseases by reducing the saturated fat content and increasing the polyunsaturated fat content of their products, and by using healthier oils.
